channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: Kia Georgia celebrates major milestones
item.description: Kia Georgia marks five million vehicles built in West Point with the 2027 Telluride, the first hybrid electric vehicle produced in Georgia and in the U.S., marking a milestone for state manufacturing.

item.title: LaFayette boys, Lanett girls advance to the Final Four
item.description: LaFayette boys edge Lanett in OT to reach Final Four; Lanett girls roll past Highland Home to punch their own Final Four tickets in Birmingham.

item.title: How Long Personal Injury Cases Typically Take in Duluth, Georgia
item.description: Being injured due to someone else's negligence brings uncertainty, bills accumulate, income stops, and recovery is demanding.

item.title: Community-wide fellowship events set for this Saturday
item.description: Osanippa Baptist in Lanett revives its community Men’s Breakfast and Fourth Saturday Night Singings this Saturday, Feb. 28, with free breakfast and evening gospel music.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Lynn Gendusa: The Only Way to Win
item.description: A daughter reflects on her fiercely competitive mother and discovers why integrity, humility and kindness—not just winning—are the real mark of a champion.

item.title: Community prayer event coming to Troup County
item.description: First-ever “Praise & Prayer On the Square” will bring free worship, prayer, music and messages to Lafayette Square in downtown LaGrange on March 28, 10 a.m.–noon.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Bill King: Is Your Christmas Tree Still Up?
item.description: Bill King reflects on how long Christmas trees stay up, from Epiphany traditions to year‑round trees, and why some families take theirs down the day after Christmas.

item.title: Valley council hears from Sara Crutchfield
item.description: Valley council delays new employee handbook vote as Pancake Day returns, alcohol permits are approved, free trees announced and local milestones honored.

item.title: Conservation fundraising banquet returns next month
item.description: Chambers County Ducks Unlimited hosts its third annual March 19 banquet at The Oaks Farm, raising funds for national wetland conservation and waterfowl habitat.

item.title: Point University honors retiring staff member
item.description: Point University will launch the Wye Huxford Center for Spiritual Formation to honor the retiring dean’s 50 years of shaping students’ faith and leadership.
